svg.text: Five bicycle types. Five distinct silhouettes.
Visual target board for the Bicycle Illustration Specialist agent — concept sketches, not release assets.
Slim tires · drop bars · rigid fork
Shared frame and weak road posture
Low cockpit, hoods and clean brake detail
Shock/linkage reads as a loose strut
Integrated shock, pivots, fork and disc brakes
Upright frame, fenders and rack option
Looks like a road bike with wider tires
Relaxed geometry, flared drops and disc setup
Electrical parts appear pasted onto a template
Declared subtype, integrated battery and motor at BB
The silhouette must identify the category before color, label or UI text does. All component click regions must match the physical part.
